text_block_list.text:
At Maruzensky's invitation, I ended up 
going to the resort hotel's pre-opening 
event.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Man, look at this turnout! Total madness! 
Alright you, wanna play 100-board Human 
Shogi with me?! I'm the King, and you're 
the superstar hair stylist!
choice_data_list:
I-It's so crowded you could actually 
imagine that!
I-It's lively enough to make you think so!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I came because I heard about a grand 
renewal, but it really doesn't look any 
different at all.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Even with the famous Maruzensky doing PR, 
this is kind of a letdown. Did she just 
get asked and couldn't say no...?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
U-Um, excuse me...! Maruzen-san wouldn't 
do something like—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hiiya! Everyone! Welcome, and thank you 
for traveling so far to our resort!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Now then, I'd like you all to enjoy the 
special highlight course of our renewal! 
We call it—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
The 'One-Day Noble Lady & Gentleman' 
Experience!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
From now until the end of the day, each 
guest will have a dedicated butler to 
attend to their every need♪

text_block_list.name: Staff Playing Butler
text_block_list.text:
Lord <username>, I shall be attending to your side 
today. Please feel free to command me as 
you see fit.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
First up is spa time! Please take your 
time and soak away all your daily fatigue♪

text_block_list.name: Staff Playing Butler
text_block_list.text:
My Lady, how is the water temperature? May 
I fetch you something to drink?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Oho, you're pretty attentive, ain't ya! 
Then get me some oden broth, and make sure 
it's ice-freakin'-cold!

text_block_list.name: Staff Playing Butler
text_block_list.text: Understood. Please allow me a moment.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
W-Well... this level of service is 
something any place could pull off if they 
really tried.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Next, please enjoy afternoon tea in a 
salon that was once used as a high-society 
gathering parlor!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
My, to serve without using a tea stand... 
This is remarkably authentic, desu wa!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
From the teacups down to the silverware, 
every single piece of furniture is 
top-notch— one can truly feel the immense 
dedication, desu wa!

text_block_list.name: Manager
text_block_list.text:
We are deeply honored by your praise. In 
fact, a famous Taisho-era 
semi-autobiographical novel was written 
based on our establishment's tea time—

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
What?! This was the setting for that 
masterpiece?! To think we could experience 
the very same taste described in the 
book...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Now, it's photo shoot time! Please pick 
your favorite dress and accessories from 
this wardrobe!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Wow, they're all so wonderful, I can't 
decide! 'A gorgeous dress outshines even a 
cat's paw pads,' as the saying might 
go...!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
I see. 'In modern times where formal dress 
is rare, it offers a remarkably fresh 
experience'... got it. ...Excuse me, how 
many participants can you accommodate?

And so, the dazzling noble lady and 
gentleman experience continued throughout 
the entire day—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Well then, that concludes our course! To 
wrap things up, our manager would like to 
say a few words!

text_block_list.name: Manager
text_block_list.text:
...Everyone, thank you very much for 
coming today. In these times where trends 
shift with dizzying speed, our 
establishment is undoubtedly 'outdated'.

text_block_list.name: Manager
text_block_list.text:
However, we firmly believe. Even as eras 
change, the human heart remains unchanged.

text_block_list.name: Manager
text_block_list.text:
When it comes to what captivates and 
flutters one's heart, whether something is 
new or old is irrelevant. What truly 
matters is—

text_block_list.name: Manager
text_block_list.text:
That it is an 'authentic masterpiece', 
crafted and polished with relentless 
dedication.

text_block_list.name: Manager
text_block_list.text:
Believing this, we decided to present our 
hospitality in this manner today.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
...Believing in what makes our hearts 
flutter, and desperately keeping that 
passion alive—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
If you were able to feel the passionate 
and proud spirit of our staff throughout 
this day, I couldn't be happier.

text_block_list.name: All Staff Members
text_block_list.text:
We eagerly await your visit. We look 
forward to serving you again...!
(...Clap, clap, clap, clap!)

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Man, that was magnificent...! The 
facility's history and everyone's burning 
passion really got through to us... It 
feels as though my soul has been cleansed.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
We'll definitely write up a full feature 
on this: 'The Revival of a Prestigious 
Resort'!

While getting ready to leave, I saw 
Maruzensky standing by the beach.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Phew, the sea breeze feels wonderful...! I 
truly love this ocean so much.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
It's calm, it's vast, and besides— it 
somehow looks extraordinarily sparkling 
today.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I will always believe in what makes my 
heart skip a beat. Even if it's old, even 
if it's outdated.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I've gotta cherish my own definition of 
'trendy' even more from now on, too♪
